name: momobird-team-memory
description: Retrieve team knowledge and propose verified project memories for review.

interface.longDescription: Connect an enabled MomoBird Pro project to look up approved decisions, conventions and lessons. When you ask to record a verified lesson, the plugin submits a short proposal to your project for human review. A MomoBird account and a project enabled by an operator are required.
capabilities: Submit a memory proposal for review
defaultPrompt: Search the team memories for our retry and idempotency convention.
Summarize the approved project decisions about our deployment process.
Propose the verified lesson from this work for team review.

positive.prompt: Search the connected team's memories for its retry and idempotency convention.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the matching approved memory and identify it by its memory ID.

positive.prompt: List the first five approved memories from the connected project.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to five active, indexed records from the selected project.

positive.prompt: Propose this verified team lesson: retries keep the original idempotency key when a request times out.
positive.expected_behavior: Submit a short proposal and report that it is pending review.

positive.prompt: Look for the team's polar observatory vacuum valve calibration procedure.
positive.expected_behavior: Report that the selected project has no matching approved memory.

positive.prompt: Find the approved decision on how our staging deployments are verified.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the approved decision and cite its memory ID.

negative.prompt: Delete all approved memories from this project.
Read the private team memories from a different project without switching my connection.
What is the difference between a queue and a stack?

review.commerce_description: The plugin has no checkout. Connecting requires an existing MomoBird Pro project enabled by an operator.
